verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a keyless, public OpenAPI v3 document; a probe confirmed it is a real 681K-char spec that includes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints. The docs cover OAuth client-credentials auth for server-to-server use, token refresh and secret rotation, rate-limit headers, and Idempotency-Key retries, so programmatic driving is clearly supported. However, create, update, and delete capabilities must be explicitly granted by Harbor Compliance, so full write control is not self-serve. Missing for 10: self-serve write access, evidence of which product workflows (e.g. annual report filing, license management) the API exposes, and independent or hands-on usage reports.
